_comment: THE MILL'S CLIMATE AND SEASON SKINS, read out of the Models/Finished/
41600_*.prefab variants in Kamer's 'Windmills of Daggerfall' v2.0,
vendored with the author's permission (see README.md).
Only TWO of the body's five texture groups ever change: Walls (slot 0)
and Roof (slot 2). Plank and Windmill stay 067_1 and the Door stays
332_0 in every one of his seventeen variant prefabs.
These are HIS records, not a climate rebase. Daggerfall's own
ClimateSwaps law would rebase 364 -> 064/164/464 by climate base and
add 1 for winter, and his walls DO follow that - but his roofs do not
(369_3 temperate, 069_1 desert, 369_0 mountain, 369_1 swamp, and one
snow roof 103_1 shared by every winter). He picked them by eye, so
they are carried verbatim rather than derived.
DESERT NEVER WINTERS: his DesertWinter prefab is identical to his
Desert one, which is the same rule ClimateSwaps.cs states outright.
Mountain's Fall and Spring prefabs are full files identical to its
base (an earlier note here called them empty - they are not), so they
carry the base skin, as Fall and Spring do everywhere else. Temperate
has NO Fall/Spring/Summer prefab at all; MeshReplacement.GetName falls
back to plain 41600, which is the temperate body, so the same skin.
DFU asks for exactly ONE name per climate (MeshReplacement.cs:329-343):
`41600_Desert` for desert, `41600_{Climate}{Season}` otherwise, then
`41600`. So his 41600_DesertFall/Spring/Winter and '41600_Desert 1'
prefabs - the ones built on New_Windmill 2 Desert.dae, whose roof peak
is lowered to the eave (vertex 188: y 10.8351 -> 7.4787) - are never
resolved by DFU and are not carried.
Applied through the port's own texRemap, the same door applyClimate
uses for every other model, so the mill is re-skinned the way the
game re-skins a building.
